verdict.rationale: Only community evidence covers vendor-specific acceleration. One user reports running Ollama on an AMD RX 6650 with ROCm containers shipped since 0.1.27, and another notes native MLX support on Apple Silicon. A separate report shows ROCm detection failing and falling back to CPU, which suggests AMD support can be fragile. missing for 10: any evidence of NVIDIA/CUDA support, first-party documentation of supported GPU vendors and backends, and reliable AMD ROCm compatibility guidance.
